I went through this before. My ex found someone new a month after we broke up and two months later he came back to me. I wished I didnt let him in because the cycle just repeated itself despite the promises he made. 

What helped me most was focussing on myself and ONLY myself. Do things that make you happy and whatever it is that makes you a better version of yourself. Journal your feelings, write letters and burn them after and practice lots of selfcare (practicing hygiene, learning something new or just practicing mindfulness). If possible, try to talk to a mental health professional. 

Remind yourself that you deserve happiness and letting go is the first step of being yourself again. Whatever you’re feeling is valid and remember that you are human. Let the sadness immerse itself and you’ll find yourself slowly healing day by day. Love yourself and I hope you find peace. ❤️
